title: Thomas Townsend Brown's thrust from asymmetric capacitors

tellings.quote: mid-century inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, who discovered that when you apply a high voltage to certain asymmetric capacitors, they produce thrust.

plain: A mid-century inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have discovered that when you put a high voltage across certain asymmetric capacitors, electrical parts made of two plates of different shapes or sizes, "they produce thrust," that is, they push themselves along. Michels says this himself on an episode about Bob Lazar, a man who claims he worked on alien craft for the government. If true, electricity alone could move a craft, with no fuel burned.
